title: Apply outcome
description: POST /apply 200 reply, and each entry of a plan's outcomes. A blocked or conflicting apply is not this body: it is a problem+json (APPLY_BLOCKED 422, BINDING_CONFLICT 409) carrying these fields as extension members. account_id and standing appear together, and only when an account exists.

observed.description: The managed fields as the TARGET reported them after the write; absent when unverified. A limit field is the effective limit the target now holds (one value, as subjects state reports it), left out when it could not be read.

BindingConflict.description: An unbound target account already holds the derived name.
